parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: JobCode
parameters.description: The ID of the push task. The **Data** field returned after a successful call to [PushSpeech](~~217573~~) is the push task ID.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The push task status. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried. Valid values:

- **RUNNING**: Running.
- **SENDING**: Sending.
- **CANCEL**: Canceled.
- **SUCCESS**: Succeeded.
- **TIMEOUT**: Timed out.
